subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(II)-9 — the section on cultural-information focus as the structural ground beneath the present reality of creative music. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'It is important that this idea is challenged — because the present situation we are now living in has not simply come from nowhere.' The crossing diagrams how political-dynamics structurally meets world-expansion-principle to produce the present-situation the prose names: (C)POL-DYM (the concept of political dynamics) crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). POL-DYM sits on the left with the subject-arrow; STF (source transfer) branches from the main line and runs to the left margin; LG-EXT (logical extension) and PRI-INFO (principle information) branch from STF, and SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) from PRI-INFO. TRS (transition) rises from the main line; SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) branches from TRS, and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) from SOC-RT-DY. WO-EXP-PRI is the partner-axis at lower-right.
